verdict.rationale: dLocal's first-party docs describe a public API for programmatic payments. Merchants can build custom checkouts, read Pix parameters returned by the API, charge saved cards by `card_id`, and test API behavior in a Sandbox by passing values in the request body. The OpenAPI probe returned 404 on common paths, but that only means no spec was found at those URLs; it doesn't contradict the documented API. Missing for 10: an evidenced API reference with an endpoint catalog, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: With dLocal API you can build your own payment form and take full control over the look and feel and experience of your checkout.
The important parameters are returned via API, so the merchant can build their own Pix UI.
In Sandbox, you can control the payment result by passing a status code in the request body's `description` field.
For recurring payments, first save the card, and then use the `card_id` to charge the card.
